mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions, which reduces corporate cost pressures and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of months where UNRATE declines by at least 0.2pp, or the Rank IC between UNRATE change and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of months where UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or near zero and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, the market anticipates prolonged recessionary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% and INDPRO declines by at least 1.0% month-over-month, or the interaction term in a regression of 20d returns on INDPRO change and FEDFUNDS is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery regime, a monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of months during the post-crisis recovery period where HOUST increases by at least 0.5%, or the Rank IC between HOUST change and 60d returns in the recovery regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) reading below 90.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of months where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1pp, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS change and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly residential mortgage loan volume (RSAFS) below 300,000 million dollars signals reduced consumer credit availability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of months where RSAFS < 300000, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level signals robust manufacturing activity, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of months where INDPRO is above 95.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
